1.why: Moffenzeef 2.6.1 source (github.com/moffenzeefmodular/VCVrack-submission commit e6a0c67), src/BusMult.cpp:52: inputs[IN2_INPUT].isConnected() ? inputs[IN2_INPUT].getVoltage() : input1; mono: the plugin reads every input with getVoltage() and the only setChannels in src is Kleztizer.cpp:305

comment: Read from the maker's source at 2.6.1, commit e6a0c67. BusMult::process checks leftExpander.module, compares its model against modelBusMult and, when input 1 is not connected, reads the neighbour's bus value at Module+0x148. It writes its own bus value there every sample. No family is set on these jacks because a mult carries whatever is given to it. Neither jack is given a range, because a mult carries whatever is patched into it.
